🐉
DRAGONBOUND
QUEST

A dark-fantasy adventure. Gather supplies, master your blade, and uncover the secret buried beneath the village.

VILLAGE • SWAMPLANDS • DUNGEON • SURVIVE

🎒 Adventurer's Pack

Choose food or a potion to use.

🔥 Village Cookfire

Turn ingredients into food to restore hunger.

✨ Spellbook

Spells use magic and recharge over time.

🛒 Village Provisions

Trade gold for supplies. The keeper is always here.

📜 Field Notes

Village: Safe place to recover and cook at the fire.

Swamplands: Find the ancient stone and gather moss.

Whispering Woods: Help the ranger hunt the brutes.

Frostfell Highlands: Find the oracle and hunt the frost wyrms.

Dungeon: Explore the stone halls; the western arch returns you to the swamplands.

Controls: Move with WASD, arrow keys, or the joystick. Enter or Space confirms and interacts; E interacts; I opens inventory; Q opens spells; M opens the dungeon map; F opens the quest journal; J attacks; hold Left Shift to defend (O also works); R rolls; C sneaks; H starts the hearth charm; Escape goes back. Use the visible Fullscreen button to toggle fullscreen.

Quest: Gather 3 dungeon stones and 2 herbs, then return to the village elder.

🔒 Threefold Rune Seal

The worn inscription reads: “Let flame wake moon; let moon welcome leaf.”
